text: They are neither superior or luxurious but our young man liked the design so score for that.. They look exactly like the picture. For the price I would expect a thicker quality and a bath sheet included, the set contains 2 towels (not bath sheets - although they offer bath sheets separately), 2 hand towels & 2 wash cloths. Perfect for sending your kid off to college or their first apartment.

product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR Collection Luxurious Stripes Combed Cotton 2-Piece Bath Towel Set, Charcoal
features: GREAT VALUE. This set includes 2 bath towels measuring 30" x 52" each
CLASSIC STRIPES. These striped towels will add a bold pop of color, making them the perfect addition to any bathroom
TWO PLY CONSTRUCTION. These 550 GSM towels are made with double the amount of fibers, making them more durable and absorbent than single ply towels

LONG-STAPLE COMBED COTTON. Superior's 100% Long-Staple Cotton is specially combed to remove all but the finest and longest fibers, making these towels the ultimate in luxury. Thirstier than Turkish cotton and softer and more durable than standard cotton, our longer fibers can be spun thinner, which increases the comfort and absorbency of these towels
EASE OF CARE. These beautiful towels are colorfast and machine washable. For drying, tumble dry low and remove them promptly from dryer. Always follow care label instructions for best results
description: Experience pure luxury with these absorbent towels made from premium long-staple combed cotton. Featuring stripes of four different colors, these elegant towels are both soft and absorbent for truly luxurious experience any day. Provide an eye catching update to any bathroom décor with these Superior 550 GSM towels.
We have been manufacturing fine linens for over 40 years. We are experts in manufacturing high quality textiles and pride ourselves on only producing the finest products.
